support-bot: Escalation: ingest throttling causing 429s for multiple onboarding tenants (Gridly, NovaPay, HealthArc). ~2,100 docs queued since 12:05 PT. Escalating to CS for priority handling and customer comms. @Cheng L @Maria S
Cheng L: Are these Hosted or Dedicated accounts? Any PII in the payloads?
support-bot: Hosted. No PII in samples. Error shows `quota_exceeded: ingest_rate_limit`. Logs: https://internal-logs.redwood/ingest/199876 (internal)
Alex M: Need backlog size (docs + tokens) and per-account rate limits to estimate clear time.
support-bot: Backlog: 2,100 docs (~450k tokens). Per-account ingest rate = 100 req/min. System saturated due to concurrent onboards.
Maria S: Gridly is POC, renewal touchpoint in ~45 days. This is a renewal risk if uploads stay delayed. Recommend proactive comms + temporary mitigation (quota bump or dedicated ingest window).
CS Lead: Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate note to affected customers acknowledging issue; 2) Offer temporary quota bump + expedited backfill window; 3) Follow-up recap + credit if SLA missed; 4) Exec escalation if churn risk. Draft message below.
Alex M: Share draft & ops steps to apply bump. Tag finance if credits > $1k.
CS Lead: Draft customer message: "Hi <Customer>, we detected an ingestion delay affecting recent uploads. We9re sorry. We9re provisioning a temporary ingest rate increase to clear queued items, monitoring progress every 30-60 minutes, and offering a post-incident review and possible credit. Estimated clear time: ~3-4 hours after increase. Contact: maria@redwood.com."
Cheng L: Ops runbook excerpt to bump & backfill:
```bash
# bump ingest rate for tenant
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/admin/tenants/{tenant_id}/quota \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"ingest_rate":250,"duration_minutes":240}'
# trigger backfill job
POST https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/{tenant_id}/jobs -d '{"type":"ingest_backfill"}'
```
support-bot: Bump applied to NovaPay (bump-AX7). NovaPay backlog cleared: 720 docs. Completed 12:50 PT.
Alex M: Please bump Gridly next and confirm ETA.
support-bot: Gridly bump started 12:57 PT (bump-GZ4). Estimated time ~3.5 hours. Will post updates every 30 mins.
Katie R: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingest-throttle (steps 2-5 for bump + verification).
Maria S: Sending tailored comms to Gridly & NovaPay now. Offering HealthArc a dedicated ingest window tomorrow AM or credits. Finance: pre-approve credits > $1k if needed.
CS Lead: Action items: Cheng - coordinate bumps; Support - progress updates every 30 mins; Maria - send comms & copy renewals for Gridly; Alex - 1:1 after backfill to discuss quota defaults. I will own exec escalation if Gridly flags churn risk.
support-bot: Status 13:27 PT - Gridly throughput +60%, remaining docs ~1,100.
Cheng L: Monitoring good. No errors from the bump. Keeping temporary rate for 4 hours then rollback.
Maria S: Gridly acknowledged; requested hourly updates. I told them ETA ~1:40 PT and recapped follow-up offer. Logging notes in Gainsight and marking Gridly 'At Risk - POC'.
Alex M: Postmortem needed: root cause + recommended default quotas for POCs.
Cheng L: Will attach perf/ingest metrics to INC-199876 for analysis.
CS Lead: Great cross-team response. Keep thread updated until all backfills complete and any credits are resolved. If a customer asks for an exec call, flag me immediately.
